newsitem.title: USA: Colonial BancGroup buys Fort Brooke for $33.6 million.
newsitem.headline: Colonial BancGroup buys Fort Brooke for $33.6 million.

text.p: Alabama-based Colonial BancGroup Inc. said Tuesday it signed a letter of intent to acquire Florida-based Fort Brooke Bancorporation for $33.6 million.

The banks said Colonial will exchange stock equal to $31.50 per share for Fort Brooke's outstanding shares, a value of $31.7 million. Colonial will also assume Fort Brooke's options based on $31.50 per share, bringing the total value of the deal to $33.6 million.
Colonial BancGroup, a multi-bank holding company, said it has assets of $4.7 billion and 132 offices in Alabama, Florida, Georgia and Tennessee.
Fort Brooke had $186 million in assets, $16.3 million in capital and earnings of $1 million on June 30, the banks said. It operates eight offices in the greater Tampa area.
Colonial's stock did not trade early Tuesday after closing Monday at $34.75 on the New York Stock Exchange.
